import pandas as pd,numpy as np,statsmodels.formula.api as smf,sys
w=pd.read_parquet(sys.argv[1])
w['y']=w['count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL']/w.n_passages
w['late']=(w.year>=1876).astype(int)
print(w.year.isna().sum())
def est(d):
    g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).y.mean().unstack()
    return (g[1]-g[0]).mean(), g
e,g=est(w);print(e);print(g)
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
for i in range(1000):
    d=w.groupby(['genre','late'],group_keys=False).apply(lambda x:x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)))
    bs.append(est(d)[0])
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
print(pd.crosstab(w.genre,w.late,normalize='columns'))
print(pd.crosstab(w.origin,w.late,normalize='columns'));print(pd.crosstab(w.date_confidence,w.late,normalize='columns'))
print(w.groupby('late').n_editions.mean())
w['prod']=w.groupby('author_key').work_id.transform('count');print(w.groupby('late')['prod'].mean())
for dc in ['high','medium','low']:
    print(dc,est(w[w.date_confidence==dc])[0])
for o in ['UK','US','unknown']: print(o,est(w[w.origin==o])[0])
m=smf.ols('y~late+C(genre)+C(origin)+C(date_confidence)+np.log(n_editions)+np.log(prod)',w).fit(cov_type='cluster',cov_kwds={'groups':pd.factorize(w.author_key)[0]})
print(m.params['late'],m.conf_int().loc['late'])
print(w.groupby('decade').y.mean())
